column3: “the valley of the Arnon” renders “the wadi of Arnon”; “toward the sunrise” renders “the rising of the sun.”
“the valley” renders “the wadi”; “the brook Jabbok” renders “Jabbok the wadi.”
“Lasharon” transliterates the Hebrew “to-the-Sharon” as a name.
“the heights of Dor” renders “Naphath of Dor.”
